book.name: Yoohana
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Yoohana

content: Mariyamu arahaka Yɨɨsu amaguta
Hanʉ zasaagirɨ sikʉ isaasabha kuhika isigukuru yɨ Ɨpasaka, Yɨɨsu akahika naatu Bhɨtaniya, ɨnʉ aaryurirɨ Razaarʉ kurwa mʉbhaku.
Mmbe, abhaatʉ bha ahagero hayo bhakamokorera ɨnyangi. Maarita akamohokerya, na Razaarʉ aarɨ wʉmwɨ wa bhanʉ bhaarɨ komeeza hamwɨmwɨ na Yɨɨsu.

Neho Mariyamu akagega ichupa ya amaguta ga naridʉ. Amaguta gayo gaarɨ gi iguri ikʉrʉ na garareetya bhwaheene. Akahaka Yɨɨsu kʉmagʉrʉ, akamʉtaricha na zinzwɨrɨ zaazɨ. Inyumba ngima ikiizʉra uruhuzu rwa amaguta gayo.
Nawe wʉmwɨ wa abhɨɨga bhaazɨ iriina ryazɨ Yuuda Isikariyʉʉti, na newe ariichʉrɨ Yɨɨsu, akabhuga,
“Kwakɨ amaguta gayo gataguriibhwɨ zidinaari magana atatʉ
na kʉhaabhwa abhahabhɨ?”
Yuuda ataagambirɨbhu igʉrʉ wo okororera abhahabhɨ ɨbhɨgʉngi, nawe nɨ‑kʉ kʉbha aarɨ mwibhi. Newe aarɨ akʉbhɨɨka ɨkɨgʉzi cha zimpirya, na aarɨ ariibha zimpirya zɨnʉ zatɨɨrwɨ mʉkɨgʉzi kiyo.
Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akabhuga, “Mutigɨ, kʉ kʉbha anhakirɨ amaguta igʉrʉ yu urusikʉ rʉnʉ bhakʉmbɨɨka.
Abhahabhɨ mʉnabhʉ sikʉ zʉʉsi, nawe inyɨ nɨtakʉbha na niimwɨ sikʉ zʉʉsi.”
Abhakangati bha Abhayaahudi bhariiseemerya kwita Razaarʉ
Mmbe, Abhayaahudi bhaaru bhakiigwa kʉbha Yɨɨsu aarɨ iyo, bhakaja komorora, ɨtarɨ ewe umwene, nawe na Razaarʉ wʉnʉ Yɨɨsu aaryurirɨ kurwa mʉbhaku.
Neho abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani bhakakora ɨsɨɨmi yu ukwita Razaarʉ wʉʉsi,
kʉ kʉbha igʉrʉ waazɨ, Abhayaahudi bhaaru bhaarɨ bhariiyaahʉra na abhakangati bhaabhʉ, bhakiisirirya Yɨɨsu.
Yɨɨsu arasʉngʼaanwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu ncha Masiya
Tabhʉʉri waho, riribhita ikʉrʉ rya abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhiizirɨ kurya isigukuru yɨ Ɨpasaka, bhakiigwa kʉbha Yɨɨsu arɨ mʉnzɨra kuuza Yɨrusarɨɨmu.
Mmbe, bhakagega ibhisha bhye emetende, bhakaja kʉmʉsʉngʼaana Yɨɨsu. Bhakatiirya riraka bharabhuga,

content.text: Anʉ ʉrʉbhangʉ wʉnʉ akuuza kuriina ryʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ!

content: Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akabhona umwana wɨ ɨtɨkɨrɨ, akiikara igʉrʉ wayʉ chɨmbu yandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu,
Ribhaga riyo, abhɨɨga bha Yɨɨsu bhataagamɨnyirɨ amangʼana gayo. Nawe hanʉ Yɨɨsu aaryukirɨ neho bhaahiitirɨ kʉbha amangʼana gayo nɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na nɨmbu bhaamʉkʉrɨɨrɨ.
Abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaarɨ na Yɨɨsu ribhaga rɨnʉ aabhirikiirɨ Razaarʉ kurwa mumbihɨra na kumuryʉra kurwa kʉbhaku, bhakabha bharanyaraganʼya ɨngʼana yiyo kʉbhaatʉ.
Kʉgayo, abhaatʉ bhaaru bhaarɨ bhiigwirɨ igʉrʉ wi ichɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ kɨnʉ Yɨɨsu aakʉrirɨ, ɨkagirya abhaatʉ bhakarwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu kuja kʉmʉsʉngʼaana.
Nawe Abhafarisaayo bhakiibhʉʉrɨra, “Mʉrarora, tʉtakʉtʉra kokora chʉchʉsi! Rora, abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bharamutuna.”
Yɨɨsu aragamba igʉrʉ wu uruku rwazɨ
Kwarɨ na abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatarɨ Abhayaahudi gatɨ wa abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaagiirɨ Yɨrusarɨɨmu kusigukuru yɨ Ɨpasaka kosengera Mungu.
Mmbe, abhaatʉ bhayo bhakaja kwa Firipʉ wa Bhɨtɨsaida mucharʉ cha Gariraaya, bhakamʉsabha, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, tʉrasabha turumanɨ na Yɨɨsu.”
Firipʉ akaja kʉbhʉʉrɨra Andureya amangʼana gayo, akʉmara bhʉʉsi bhabhɨrɨ bhakaja kʉbhʉʉrɨra Yɨɨsu.
Yɨɨsu akabhuga, “Ribhaga rihikirɨ ryu Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ kugungibhwa.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, arɨɨbhɨ endetere yɨ ɨnganʉ ɨkɨɨrɨ kugwa mwirobha na kukwa, ɨtakʉtʉra komera. Nawe arɨɨbhɨ igwirɨ na kukwa, neho ekomera na kwibhʉra imisumʉ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ asɨɨgirɨ ʉbhʉhʉru bhwazɨ umwene, arabhurimirya. Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akubhiihirirwa ʉbhʉhʉru bhwazɨ mʉʉsɨ yɨnʉ, wuyo arahonʼya nʉʉrʉ ʉbhʉhʉru bhwazɨ kemerano.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akonhokerya, ereenderwa antunɨ. Hʉhʉʉsi hanʉ nɨrɨ, hayo neho no omohocha waanɨ akʉbha. Bhaabha arasʉʉka ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akonhokerya.”

Yɨɨsu akabhuga, “Nangʉ ekoro yaanɨ irumikirɨ bhʉkʉngʼu. Nibhugɨbhwɨ? Nibhugɨ, ‘Bhaabha, nɨrakʉsabha ʉnsabhʉrɨ kwibhaga ryɨ ɨnyaakʉ rɨnʉ?’ Nɨtakʉtʉra kʉmʉsabhabhu, kʉ kʉbha niizirɨ mʉʉsɨ yɨnʉ korereke nebhone ɨnyaakʉ yiyo.
Bhaabha Mungu, werekenʼye ʉbhʉgʉngʉ bhwi iriina ryazʉ.” Neho riraka rɨkarwa mwisaarʉ rɨrabhuga, “Nɨrɨkɨɨnʼyɨ ʉbhʉgʉngʉ bhwanɨ, na kwikɨ nereerekanʼya.”
Hanʉ riribhita rya abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhiimiiriirɨ hayo bhiigwirɨ, abhandɨ bhakabhuga, “Ʉrʉkʉbha rʉparukirɨ,” na abhandɨ bhakabhuga, “Maraika agambɨɨnɨ nawe.”
Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Riraka rɨnʉ mwigwirɨ rɨtarɨ igʉrʉ waanɨ, nawe igʉrʉ waanyu.
Nangʉ rihikirɨ ribhaga ryʉ ʉkʉtɨnɨra ɨɨsɨ yɨnʉ. Na rihikirɨ ribhaga ryo okoheebha Shɨtaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨ ɨɨsɨ.
Hanʉ inyɨ nikutiiribhwa igʉrʉ, nɨraruta bhʉʉsi, bhaazɨ kwa niinyɨ.”
Yɨɨsu akagambabhu, kwerecha uruku rwazɨ kʉmʉsarabha.
Mmbe, abhaatʉ bhayo bhakagarukirya, “Tʉsʉmirɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu, Kiriisitʉ arabha ariikara kemerano.
Nangʉ, kwakɨ ʉrabhuga, ereenderwa Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ atiiribhwɨ igʉrʉ? Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ?”

Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Ubhwɨrʉ bhʉrabha hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ kwibhaga isuuhubhu. Mʉkajɨ kogenda mubhwɨrʉ bhʉnʉ mʉnabhwɨ, korereke ikiirimya kɨtaaza kʉbhahiza, kʉ kʉbha ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akogenda mukiirimya, atɨɨzɨ hanʉ akuja.
Kwa ribhaga rɨnʉ munu ubhwɨrʉ, mwisiriryɨ ubhwɨrʉ bhuyo, korereke mʉbhɨ abhaana bhu ubhwɨrʉ.” Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aamarirɨ kʉgamba gayo, akatiga riribhita rya abhaatʉ bhayo, akiibhisa.
Abhayaahudi bhaaru bharaanga kwisirirya Yɨɨsu
Nangabha Yɨɨsu akakora ibhyɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ bhyaru mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwabhʉ, abhaatʉ bhaaru bhatamwisiriiryɨ.
Ɨkabhabhu korereke gahikɨ amangʼana ganʉ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri Isaaya aagambirɨ,

content.text: Na, nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ wʉnʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ aamwɨrɨchiryɨ amanaga gaazɨ?”

content: Bhatamwisiriiryɨ kʉ kʉbha Mungu akagamba naatu kʉhɨtɨra kwa Isaaya,
Isaaya akarora ʉbhʉkʉrʉ bhwa Yɨɨsu, akagamba amangʼana gayo igʉrʉ waazɨ.
Nʉʉrʉbhu abhakangati bhaaru bha Abhayaahudi bhakiisirirya Yɨɨsu, nawe bhataagambirɨ habhwɨrʉ kʉbha bhamwisiriiryɨ, kʉ kʉbha bhaarɨ bharʉʉbhaha koheebhwa na Abhafarisaayo mwirwazɨrʉ.
Abhakangati bhayo bhakasɨɨga bhʉkʉngʼu kukumibhwa na abhaatʉ, kʉkɨra kukumibhwa na Mungu.
Abhaatʉ bharatinirwa kʉmangʼana ganʉ Yɨɨsu agambirɨ
Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akagamba kwiraka ikʉrʉ, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akunyiisirirya inyɨ, atakunyiisirirya inyimwene, nawe ariisirirya na wʉnʉ antumirɨ.
Wʉnʉ akondora inyɨ, arʉʉzɨ na wʉnʉ antumirɨ.
Inyɨ niinyɨ ubhwɨrʉ, niizirɨ kʉʉsɨ kʉnʉ korereke bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakunyiisirirya bhatigɨ kʉbha mukiirimya.
“Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akwigwa amangʼana gaanɨ, nawe atamɨ kʉgagwata, inyɨ nɨtakʉmʉtɨnɨra, kʉ kʉbha nitiizirɨ mʉʉsɨ kʉtɨnɨra abhaatʉ, nawe kʉbhasabhʉra.
Ɨbhuɨbhu, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉnyanga inyɨ na amangʼana gaanɨ, araaza ukutinirwa. Amangʼana ganʉ nɨgambirɨ nego gakuuza kʉmʉtɨnɨra urusikʉ rwɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ.
Inyɨ nɨtagambirɨ kʉbhʉnaja bhwanɨbhu, nawe Bhaabha wʉnʉ antumirɨ, newe ambuuriirɨ gʉ ʉkʉgamba na chɨmbu nɨraagambɨ.
Inyʉʉsi, nɨɨzɨ kʉbha ubhuswaja bhwazɨ bhwahaareeta ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano. Mmbe, inyɨ nɨragamba ganʉ Bhaabha antumirɨ kʉgamba ageene.”

footnotes.text: Zidinaari magana atatʉ zaarɨ nɨ‑marihi gʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ kumwaka gʉmwɨ.
a Sayuuni ni‑riina ɨrɨndɨ rya Yɨrusarɨɨmu.
